title: رحلة الباحث — The Researcher's Journey
description: A gamified Arabic (RTL) Telegram Mini App that teaches scientific research methodology through hands-on application tasks rather than recall. Learners evaluate real artifacts — journal solicitations, paper excerpts, submission screens — and defend decisions across six stations and an end-to-end capstone research journey.
